user_story: As a user, I want to interact with the collapsible accordion sections on the Accordian page so that I can view information related to 'What is Lorem Ipsum?', 'Where does it come from?', and 'Why do we use it?' by clicking on them. Upon clicking, I expect the corresponding section to expand and show more details, while the others remain collapsed. Additionally, I want to ensure that clicking on a section that is already expanded does not lead to any unexpected behavior.
